_doc: Single machine-readable SoT for mechanical bans. lint.mjs consumes this; SKILL.md and directions/_base.md point here, never restate. Only durable, statically-checkable rules live here — perishable taste lives in anti-slop.md + vision.

regexRules.message: Pure #000 reads as unfinished template. Use Zinc-950 / off-black (#0A0A0A–#18181B).
100vh / h-screen jumps on iOS Safari when the URL bar hides. Use min-h-[100dvh] or 100svh.
100vw ignores scrollbar width → horizontal overflow. Use width:100% or 100dvw.
@import creates render-blocking chains. Use <link> or a bundler.
Positive tabindex breaks natural tab order. Use only 0 or -1.
innerHTML with dynamic content is an XSS vector. Use textContent or a sanitizer.
Inline event handlers break CSP and are an XSS vector. Use addEventListener.

fonts.note: Exclusion list only. Selection method (how to PICK a font) lives in reference/type.md — prefer lesser-known geometric/humanist per direction, log the pick to design-memory. The reflex-reject serifs and Space/Plex families are now saturated AI lanes; generic system serifs (Times/Georgia/Garamond) are plain slop.
fonts.message: This font is a saturated AI-slop tell. Pick a distinctive, characterful face per reference/type.md.

copyTics.note: Short-UI-string check. em-dash in SHORT UI strings (buttons/labels/eyebrows) → warn here; em-dash in BODY/editorial copy is text-judged by the copy pass, not by regex.

markup.note: img needs meaningful alt (or alt="" if decorative) + width/height (CLS). Form inputs need <label for> (not placeholder-as-label).

contrast.note: Token-pair contrast ONLY: lint computes the WCAG ratio on the fg/bg token pairs declared in design-plan.md (pure JS, works headless). Text-on-image / gradient contrast needs rendering → vision tier, not here.

fabricatedData.note: NOT statically enforceable — flagged in the copy/editorial review pass. Never invent metrics, uptime, response times, user counts, revenue, percentages, testimonials, or logos the user didn't provide. Use bracket [placeholder] and flag it.
